purpose: Generate patient-specific piecewise-linear upper DG fluorescence boundaries using the global MMB window and DG low_cut from Module 2.

piecewise_settings.interpretation: The MMB FSC window is divided into 10 bins. Each bin receives a progressively increasing maximum allowed fluorescence, starting from anchor + one step and ending at anchor × 1.25.

piecewise_boundary.rule: For each event, interpolate max_fluorescence from the piecewise boundary using its FSC value. Keep event if fluorescence >= dg_low_cut and fluorescence <= interpolated max_fluorescence.
